ipa: /ənd sˈoʊʃəl ˌɪmpˈækts ˈʌv ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl dˌɛɡɹədˈeɪʃən ˈɑɹ pˌɑɹtˈɪkjəlɚli sˈɪɹiəs fˈɔɹ dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ kˈʌntɹiz/

text: given their dependence on national natural resources for economic growth
ipa: /ɡˈɪvən ðˈɛɹ dɪpˈɛndəns ˈɑn nˈæʃənəl nˈætʃɚəl ɹˈisɔɹsɪz fˈɔɹ ˌɛkənˈɑmɪk ɡɹˈoʊθ/

text: and their vulnerability to energy, food, water security, climate change, and extreme weather risks.
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛɹ vˌʌlnɚəbˈɪlɪti tˈu ˈɛnɚdʒi fˈud wˈɔtɚ sɪkjˈʊɹəti klˈaɪmət tʃˈeɪndʒ ənd ɛkstɹˈim wˈɛðɚ ɹˈɪsks/

text: Populations in developing nations are more reliant upon, connected
ipa: /pˌɑpjəlˈeɪʃənz ɪn dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃənz ˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ ɹɪlˈaɪənt əpˈɑn kənˈɛktɪd/

text: to, and impacted by the environment than populations in the developed world.
ipa: /tˈu ənd ˈɪmpˌæktɪd bˈaɪ ðə ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt ðˈæn pˌɑpjəlˈeɪʃənz ɪn ðə dɪvˈɛləpt wˈɝld/

text: The most at risk populations for negative impacts from environmental degradation are the rural
ipa: /ðə mˈoʊst ˈæt ɹˈɪsk pˌɑpjəlˈeɪʃənz fˈɔɹ nˈɛɡətɪv ˌɪmpˈækts fɹˈʌm ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl dˌɛɡɹədˈeɪʃən ˈɑɹ ðə ɹˈʊɹəl/

text: poor and developing nations.
ipa: /pˈuɹ ənd dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃənz/

text: Proponents of equal environmental standards for developing nations argue
ipa: /pɹəpˈoʊnənts ˈʌv ˈikwəl ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl stˈændɚdz fˈɔɹ dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃənz ˈɑɹɡju/

text: that it is in the best interest of developing nations to put in place strict environmental
ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪt ˈɪz ɪn ðə bˈɛst ˈɪntɹəst ˈʌv dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃənz tˈu pˈʊt ɪn plˈeɪs stɹˈɪkt ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl/

text: policies in order to best protect their populations.
ipa: /pˈɑləsiz ɪn ˈɔɹdɚ tˈu bˈɛst pɹətˈɛkt ðˈɛɹ pˌɑpjəlˈeɪʃənz/

text: So I can say with the definitive stance
ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈaɪ kˈæn sˈeɪ wˈɪð ðə dɪfˈɪnɪtɪv stˈæns/

text: that environmental standards indeed should be imposed, but I am in no way suggesting
ipa: /ðˈæt ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl stˈændɚdz ˌɪndˈid ʃˈʊd bˈi ˌɪmpˈoʊzd bˈʌt ˈaɪ ˈæm ɪn nˈoʊ wˈeɪ sədʒˈɛstɪŋ/

text: that the West have a right to impose these standards on developing nations
ipa: /ðˈæt ðə wˈɛst hˈæv ə ɹˈaɪt tˈu ˌɪmpˈoʊz ðˈiz stˈændɚdz ˈɑn dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃənz/

text: and just leave them to manage it alone.
ipa: /ənd dʒˈʌst lˈiv ðˈɛm tˈu mˈænədʒ ˈɪt əlˈoʊn/

text: The fact of the matter is that most of these nations lack the infrastructure
ipa: /ðə fˈækt ˈʌv ðə mˈætɚ ˈɪz ðˈæt mˈoʊst ˈʌv ðˈiz nˈeɪʃənz lˈæk ðə ˌɪnfɹəstɹˈʌktʃɚ/

text: and expertise to implement the standards that are likely to be set.
ipa: /ənd ˌɛkspɚtˈiz tˈu ˈɪmpləmənt ðə stˈændɚdz ðˈæt ˈɑɹ lˈaɪkli tˈu bˈi sˈɛt/

text: Many developing countries also have established some form of governmental structure
ipa: /mˈɛni dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ kˈʌntɹiz ˈɔlsoʊ hˈæv ɪstˈæblɪʃt sˈʌm fˈɔɹm ˈʌv ɡˈʌvɚmˌɛntəl stɹˈʌktʃɚ/

text: that seeks to address their environmental problems however,
ipa: /ðˈæt sˈiks tˈu ˈædɹˌɛs ðˈɛɹ ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl pɹˈɑbləmz hˌaʊˈɛvɚ/

text: there are inherent barriers within these governments, such as corruption,
ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ɪnhˈɪɹənt bˈæɹiɚz wɪðˈɪn ðˈiz ɡˈʌvɚmənts sˈʌtʃ ˈæz kɚˈʌpʃən/

text: bureaucratic inefficiencies, and lack of political willingness, that are preventing visible differences from being seen.
ipa: /bjˌʊɹəkɹˈætɪk ˌɪnɪfˈɪʃənsiz ənd lˈæk ˈʌv pəlˈɪtəkəl wˈɪlɪŋnəs ðˈæt ˈɑɹ pɹɪvˈɛntɪŋ vˈɪzəbəl dˈɪfɚənsɪz fɹˈʌm bˈiɪŋ sˈin/

text: Which is a classic a classic case study would be my home country, India.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ ˈɪz ə klˈæsɪk ə klˈæsɪk kˈeɪs stˈʌdi wˈʊd bˈi mˈaɪ hˈoʊm kˈʌntɹi ˈɪndiə/

text: And all the while our world is dying,
ipa: /ənd ˈɔl ðə wˈaɪl ˈaʊɚ wˈɝld ˈɪz dˈaɪɪŋ/

text: of course it is Western nations that have capitalized on industrial technology
ipa: /ˈʌv kˈɔɹs ˈɪt ˈɪz wˈɛstɚn nˈeɪʃənz ðˈæt hˈæv kˈæpɪtəlˌaɪzd ˈɑn ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəl tɛknˈɑlədʒi/

text: that have incurred these problems.
ipa: /ðˈæt hˈæv ˌɪnkˈɝd ðˈiz pɹˈɑbləmz/

text: They did it first, so it may well be thought of.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ dˈɪd ˈɪt fˈɝst sˈoʊ ˈɪt mˈeɪ wˈɛl bˈi θˈɔt ˈʌv/

text: Hypocritical of Western nations to demand developing nations
ipa: /hˌɪpəkɹˈɪtɪkəl ˈʌv wˈɛstɚn nˈeɪʃənz tˈu dɪmˈænd dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃənz/

text: who are struggling to improve their economies to maintain those standards
ipa: /hˈu ˈɑɹ stɹˈʌɡəlɪŋ tˈu ˌɪmpɹˈuv ðˈɛɹ ɪkˈɑnəmiz tˈu meɪntˈeɪn ðˈoʊz stˈændɚdz/

text: that will probably hinder their economic progress, but we need to tackle this problem.
ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɪl pɹˈɑbəblˌi hˈɪndɚ ðˈɛɹ ˌɛkənˈɑmɪk pɹˈɑɡɹˌɛs bˈʌt wˈi nˈid tˈu tˈækəl ðˈɪs pɹˈɑbləm/

text: If anything, the environmental standards placed on developing countries should serve
ipa: /ˈɪf ˈɛniθˌɪŋ ðə ɪnvˌaɪɹənmˈɛntəl stˈændɚdz plˈeɪst ˈɑn dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ kˈʌntɹiz ʃˈʊd sˈɝv/

text: as the global baseline,
ipa: /ˈæz ðə ɡlˈoʊbəl bˈeɪslˌaɪn/

text: setting a precedent for more industrialized countries to take the lead
ipa: /sˈɛtɪŋ ə pɹˈɛsɪdənt fˈɔɹ mˈɔɹ ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəlˌaɪzd kˈʌntɹiz tˈu tˈeɪk ðə lˈɛd/

text: in the path to sustainable future.
ipa: /ɪn ðə pˈæθ tˈu səstˈeɪnəbəl fjˈutʃɚ/

text: It makes no sense to say the West have industrialized irresponsibly
ipa: /ˈɪt mˈeɪks nˈoʊ sˈɛns tˈu sˈeɪ ðə wˈɛst hˈæv ˌɪndˈʌstɹiəlˌaɪzd ˌɪɹəspˈɑnsəbli/

text: and therefore the developing nation are allowed to just go ahead and do so as well.
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛɹfˌɔɹ ðə dɪvˈɛləpɪŋ nˈeɪʃən ˈɑɹ əlˈaʊd tˈu dʒˈʌst ɡˈoʊ əhˈɛd ənd dˈu sˈoʊ ˈæz wˈɛl/

text: These nations have negatively contributed to the environment through high populations,
ipa: /ðˈiz nˈeɪʃənz hˈæv nˈɛɡətɪvli kəntɹˈɪbjutɪd tˈu ðə ɪnvˈaɪɹənmənt θɹˈu hˈaɪ pˌɑpjəlˈeɪʃənz/

text: draining resources, and heavy pollution, causing havoc all over the planet.
ipa: /dɹˈeɪnɪŋ ɹˈisɔɹsɪz ənd hˈɛvi pəlˈuʃən kˈɑzɪŋ hˈævək ˈɔl ˈoʊvɚ ðə plˈænət/

text: Climate change is a global problem, and hence it is a global duty.
ipa: /klˈaɪmət tʃˈeɪndʒ ˈɪz ə ɡlˈoʊbəl pɹˈɑbləm ənd hˈɛns ˈɪt ˈɪz ə ɡlˈoʊbəl dˈuti/
